Show HN: Quasicrystals Animation Playground with WebXR
news.description:
Hi! This is my little project introducing quasicrystals animations with some parameters. It uses a custom shader to allow higher resolution.

Not all combinations look equally good. For example the "Spectrum" color palette IMO makes sense only for low values of "Tempo" and "Pattern Density".

If you have VR googles, I recommend trying the WebXR version - it's really nice.
